row.heading: Website form
row.title: Enquiry form
row.on: Open to anyone with the link
row.loadFailed: We couldn't load the form's state.

page.title: Website form
page.intro: A form you can share or put on your website. Every enquiry becomes a lead for {owner}.
page.introNoOwner: A form you can share or put on your website. Every enquiry becomes a lead for your Owner.
page.loadFailed: We couldn't load the website form.

status.heading: Status
status.on: On. Anyone with the link can send an enquiry.
status.off: Off. The link shows a short message.

closed.read_only: Closed. Your subscription is read-only, so the form isn't taking enquiries. They start again when you pay.
closed.suspended: Closed. Your organization is suspended, so the form isn't taking enquiries.
closed.cancelled: Closed. Your subscription has ended, so the form isn't taking enquiries.
closed.plan: Closed. Your plan doesn't include the form. Ask us to add it.

fields.heading: Questions
fields.intro: Only a name and a phone number are ever needed. Choose what else to ask.
fields.name: Name
fields.offers: Ask for permission to send offers

words.heading: Words
words.thankYouDefault: Thank you! {name} will get in touch with you soon.
words.websiteUrlHint: Starts with https://. Shown as a button after the thank-you.
words.privacyUrlHint: Starts with https://. Shown under the Send button.

look.heading: Look
look.intro: The form uses your logo, name and colour.
look.noLogo: No logo. The form shows your name instead.
look.name: Name
look.colourNote: Your colour is used for the Send button. Colours that are too light for white text fall back to our blue.
look.changeBranding: Change logo and colour in Branding

save.saved: Saved. The form now uses these settings.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: You changed the form's settings and haven't saved them. If you leave, they are lost.

problems.link: Use an address that starts with https://

share.heading: Share
share.noLink: Your link appears when you turn the form on.
share.embed: Allow my website to show this form
share.tryIt: Try it yourself: open the link, send an enquiry with your own number, then mark the lead Not a lead.

changeDialog.title: Change the link?
changeDialog.description: The old link and any form already on your website stop working at once. You will have to paste the new snippet.

snippet.title: Put the form on your website
snippet.description: Paste one of these where the form should appear.
snippet.scriptHelp: Paste it where the form should appear. It sizes itself to the form.
snippet.iframeHelp: Use this if your website builder won't accept scripts. Give it enough height for the form.
snippet.works: Works in Wix, WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow and plain HTML. Your visitors don't need an account.
snippet.off: The snippet is off, so a form on your website would not show. Turn on “Allow my website to show this form” to use it.
